outcome: serum cytokine levels (TNF-a, TNF-b, IL-1b, IL-6, IFN-g, IL-2, IL-12p70, IL-4, IL-5, IL-10, IL-17A, IL-8)
cohort: The study included 29 extremely preterm infants born at less than 28 weeks of gestational age.
finding: Postnatal hydrocortisone treatment provided for respiratory deterioration did not prevent BPD development, but it significantly lowered the ratio of IL-6 between the late and early phases in extremely preterm infants.
